title: CFO
description:
Our Client is a successful, stable and growing low voltage construction company of data networking, security (access control and camera), fire alarming and audio/visual systems primarily in the middle Tennessee market. Company has a renowned reputation and clients are generally well known.

Candidate will have a minimum of 5 years of in-charge experience within the construction industry in a closely held small company environment. Subcontractor experience preferred.

BS/BA degree in Accounting is required and a CPA is a plus.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • CUSTOMER focused for both external and internal customers.
  • In charge of all day-to-day accounting activities. This position will have direct supervision of 3 staff including the payroll and HR functions, accounts payable and accounts receivable functions and will be responsible for achieving satisfactory performance of the group. The inventory clerk also reports to this position.
  • Perform month end close activities, account reconciliations and accrual analysis, financial statement reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis. Prepare monthly financial statements on a timely basis.
  • Assist in the performance of deep dive cost accounting reviews of all jobs and be able to concisely explain all variances.
  • Manage monthly revenue recognition and the true up process. Create all WIP schedules and maintain accuracy of all job data in accounting system.
  • Direct the maintenance of general and subsidiary ledgers, accounts receivable, revenue distribution, depreciation, cost, property, operating expenses, and insurance records.
  • Assist in the annual review of the financial statements.
  • Evaluate the accuracy and effectiveness of the accounting system and assist external auditors in performing reviews and reviews of the accounting records.
  • Perform accounting research and analysis; make recommendations regarding appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Prepare various management presentations, financial analyses, and special projects as assigned.
  • Plan, monitor and evaluate job performance and conduct performance appraisals.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Proficient in Excel and Word with excellent organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and complete duties with little to no supervision
  • Sage 100 Contractors experience and plus
